title: Sonic orb
description: A luminous blue membrane gathers fine contours while listening and emits expanding ripples while speaking.
useCase: Distinguish voice-agent input and output states through the shape and direction of motion.
interaction: Select Idle, Listen or Speak, then adjust energy.
reducedMotion: The shader clock stops. State and energy changes redraw immediately with distinct static silhouettes.
limitations: Manual state and energy preview; no microphone, transcription or real audio amplitude. Requires native WebGL.
look: Pale blue-grey page with a glossy cobalt sphere banded by wavy navy contours inside a blue halo, above three state buttons and a slider.
motion: Contour bands drift continuously; listening adds faint inward rings and a slight edge wobble, speaking pulses the edge and emits outward ripples, with energy scaling both and states easing smoothly.
adapt: All motion is in `FRAG`: `listening` and `speaking` weights derive from `uState`, `edge` sets the silhouette, `intake` the inward rings and `ripple` the outward waves. Drive `state` and `energy` from your real voice pipeline (e.g. mic level) instead of the buttons.
